_readme: Optional price table for USD cost accounting. Token counts are always
exact in the ledger; a dollar figure is produced ONLY for a model with an
env overrides). No entry = no USD figure anywhere in reports, by design:
an unsourced price must not multiply exact tokens into a fake-exact cost.
model        exact model id as sent to the endpoint (e.g. "deepseek-chat")
source       where the price came from (provider page URL or quote ref)
effective    date the price took effect, YYYY-MM-DD
This file ships with an empty list: the repository does not hard-code any
provider's prices. Fill in an entry (with its source and effective date)
before quoting absolute dollar figures. Self-hosted or campus endpoints
usually have no marginal per-token price and need no entry.
